rationale: No existing spec covers the new 'Escape as a keyboard exit' focus behavior. logs-autocomplete-suggestions.spec.js only presses Escape to dismiss the suggest widget (and the dev's diff changed those presses to a guarded dismissSuggestionsIfOpen so they no longer assume Escape is a no-op); logs-jk-navigation.spec.js covers results-table j/k navigation, not the editor's Escape/focus contract. This is a distinct feature area (query-editor keyboard accessibility) with its own stable selectors and 3 workflows, so a dedicated Logs spec is correct. Must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the Logs-Features group.
